formula: If + had + participle, ... would + verb (past cause → present result) · If + past simple, ... would have + participle (present cause → past result)
formula_visual: [If I'd studied medicine], [I'd be a doctor now] // [If I weren't so shy], [I'd have spoken up]
when_to_use: When the condition and the result belong to DIFFERENT times. Type A: a past action with a present consequence — 'If I'd studied medicine, I'd be a doctor now.' Type B: a permanent present quality with a past consequence — 'If I weren't so shy, I'd have spoken up.' A time word ('now', 'yesterday') makes it clear.
when_to_use_ar: عندما ينتمي الشرط والنتيجة لزمنين مختلفين. النوع الأول: فعل ماضٍ بنتيجة حاضرة. النوع الثاني: صفة حاضرة دائمة بنتيجة ماضية. وكلمة زمن توضّح المعنى.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Learners memorise the three 'pure' conditionals as fixed templates, so mixing them feels like breaking a rule. In speech the distinction is only /dbi/ versus /dəv/, so even correct writing often comes out ambiguous when spoken.

examples.en: If I'd studied medicine, I'd be a doctor now.
examples.ar: لو درست الطب، لكنت طبيبًا الآن

examples.en: If she'd taken that job, she'd be living in Paris.
examples.ar: لو أخذت تلك الوظيفة، لكانت تعيش في باريس

examples.en: If I weren't so tired, I'd have gone out last night.
examples.ar: لو لم أكن متعبًا، لكنت خرجت ليلة أمس

examples.en: If he didn't work nights, he'd have come with us.
examples.ar: لو لم يعمل ليلاً، لكان جاء معنا

examples.en: If we'd saved more, we'd be able to buy a house.
examples.ar: لو وفّرنا أكثر، لكنّا قادرين على شراء بيت

common_errors.wrong: If I'd studied medicine, I'd have been a doctor now.
common_errors.correct: If I'd studied medicine, I'd be a doctor now.
common_errors.explanation: 'now' signals a present result → 'would be', not 'would have been'.

common_errors.wrong: If I wasn't so tired, I'd go out last night.
common_errors.correct: If I weren't so tired, I'd have gone out last night.
common_errors.explanation: 'last night' is a past result → 'would have gone'.

common_errors.wrong: If I would have studied medicine, I'd be a doctor.
common_errors.correct: If I'd studied medicine, I'd be a doctor.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: If I'd studied medicine, I ___ (be) a doctor now.
If I weren't so tired, I ___ (go) out last night.
If we'd left earlier, we ___ (be) home by now.
If she ___ (speak) English, she'd have got the job.
If he'd trained harder, he ___ (be) in the team today.

quick_rule: Past cause + present result → If + had + participle, would + verb. Present cause + past result → If + past simple, would have + participle. Add a time word.
quick_rule_ar: سبب ماضٍ + نتيجة حاضرة → If + had، would + فعل. سبب حاضر + نتيجة ماضية → If + ماضٍ بسيط، would have + التصريف الثالث.
mnemonic: Look at the RESULT's time, not the condition's: 'now' → would be · 'yesterday' → would have been.
connect_to_speaking: In accent week 6 you drilled /dbi/ against /dəv/ and stressing the time anchor. Say 'I'd BE a doctor NOW' against 'I'd've BEEN a doctor' — the anchor tells your listener which time frame you mean.
